summary: Pinepods is a self-hosted podcast management system designed for multiple users. It relies on a central database to keep track of user states, ensuring that listening history and interface preferences remain synchronized across different devices.
goodFor: This is a suitable option for households or small groups wanting a shared, self-hosted podcast hub that tracks progress centrally.
watchOut: As a niche media streaming application, it may lack the broader ecosystem integration and client support found in more mature podcast platforms.
deployNotes: Deployment relies on Docker containers, which typically requires configuring persistent volume mounts for the central database and media files, alongside a reverse proxy for HTTPS.
